name: Who Rules The World
description: A legendary wuxia romance that focuses on the decade-long romance between Hei Fengxi and Bai Fengxi, and the adventures they embark on together.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: The hunt for the Empyrean Token begins when news of its disappearance spreads across states. Bai Fengxi and Hei Fengxi join in for their own reasons.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: While seeking lifesaving medicine, Bai Fengxi and Hei Fengxi discover that the Han house has been burnt down, and decide to investigate.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Hei Fengxi and Bai Fengxi avenge the Han family. Yu Wuyuan arrives just in time as Shangzhou falls under attack.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Bai Fengxi returns to Tianshuangmen, where she learns about Duanhunmen. Yongzhou’s two princes decide to visit their sick brother.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: The king of Yongzhou holds a hunting competition between his sons for Feng Qiwu’s hand. Bai Fengxi starts tracking Duanhunmen.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Feng Lanxi’s past is revealed as Feng Qiwu tries to find more information about him. Bai Fengxi travels to help Duanhunmen’s next target.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Hei Fengxi faces competition for Bai Fengxi from Yu Wuyuan. Feng Ju plots to take down Feng Lanxi, but his plan goes awry.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Bai Fengxi nurses Hei Fengxi back to health, while the king of Yongzhou launches a full investigation into the fateful incident.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: As the king prepares to mourn Feng Lanxi, the truth comes out and someone has to take the blame. Queen Bai Lishi returns to the palace.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Feng Qiwu proposes marriage to Feng Lanxi. In Jizhou, Princess Huang Yu is rebuffed by Yu Wuyuan, who has his heart set on someone else.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Suspicious of Bai Fengxi, Feng Chang decides to follow her after their run-in. Huang Chao loses the talisman in an ambush.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Feng Lanxi is ordered to get to the bottom of a cheating scandal that engulfs the palace. Later, he helps Bai Fengxi settle a debt.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Bai Fengxi discovers Hei Fengxi’s double identity and helps him close the case for King Yong, who knows more than he is letting on.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Bai Fengxi bids goodbye to Hei Fengxi as she departs for Wushan in search of her master. Bai Lishi arranges a marriage for Feng Chang.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Bai Fengxi and Yu Wuyuan try to solve the Taiyin Elder’s Wushan puzzle. Hei Fengxi foils Bai Lishi’s attempt to sabotage him, then heads to Wushan.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: After a match of chess, Hei Fengxi and Bai Fengxi finally meet the Elder Taiyin and learn his technique. Yu Wuyuan’s motives are revealed.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: After the memorial for the late queen, a furious King Yong grounds Bai Lishi. But that doesn’t stop her from blackmailing Feng Chang into submission.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: A jealous Feng Ju decides to take matters into his own hands. A murder rocks the palace ahead of Feng Chang’s marriage.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: The palace is on edge as Feng Chang’s life — and the truth — hangs in the balance. Yu Wuyuan sets his plan in motion.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: An unknowing Feng Ju becomes a pawn in Yu Wuyuan’s scheme to acquire the Sacred Jade Moon. Feng Qiwu is attacked.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: To Feng Lanxi’s surprise, Bai Fengxi and Feng Qiwu hit it off. The women figure out where the money went, and Bai Fengxi has a plan to prove it.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Hei Fengxi prepares to finally confess his feelings to Bai Fengxi. However, concerns start to grow over their budding relationship.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Hei Fengxi and Bai Fengxi stop the external meddling, but duty calls before they can finish their conversation. Feng Lanxi’s enemies learn his secret.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: Hei Fengxi and Bai Fengxi arrive in Liangcheng and come up with a plan to take on Ju Ming. Princess Hua Chunran plots to stay in Youzhou.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Bai Fengxi meets with her brother and worries about Feng Lanxi finding out her true identity. The King of Jizhou realizes Huang Chao has changed.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: Feng Xiuyue tests Feng Lanxi to see if his heart is in the right place. Meanwhile, the King of Yongzhou starts investigating the Fountain Abode.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: Hua Chunran is attacked on her way back to Youzhou, but is rescued by Huang Chao. Bai Fengxi and Hei Fengxi learn of his father’s probe.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: Feng Lanxi’s plan goes south. The King of Yongzhou learns the truth, and Feng Lanxi can only beg his father for mercy.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: Master Bai starts connecting the dots. Hei Fengxi and Bai Fengxi decide to befriend Hua Chunran, who makes up her mind about who she wants to marry.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: It’s Hua Chunran’s matchmaking day and her suitors must pass multiple tests to win her hand. Huang Chao makes a proposal.

videos.title: Episode 31
videos.overview: Huang Chao and Feng Lanxi face off in a chess match for Hua Chunran. Hei Fengxi and Bai Fengxi have a conversation that changes everything.

videos.title: Episode 32
videos.overview: A murder leads to a fatal misunderstanding between Bai Langhua and Bai Fengxi. Feng Lanxi discovers a pivotal fact about his mother’s death.

videos.title: Episode 33
videos.overview: Feng Lanxi starts investigating the death of his mother, while Bai Langhua and Bai Fengxi settle their grudge.

videos.title: Episode 34
videos.overview: Justice is served as Feng Lanxi finally faces Feng Ju in front of the King of Yongzhou.

videos.title: Episode 35
videos.overview: After learning of her father’s illness, Bai Fengxi rushes back to Qingzhou, where she is urgently needed.

videos.title: Episode 36
videos.overview: As soon as a devastated Feng Xiyun becomes the empress of Qingzhou, she fends off an attack from Youzhou with Huang Chao's help.

videos.title: Episode 37
videos.overview: As the war intensifies, Huang Chao steps in for the King of Youzhou, who becomes a formidable match for Feng Xiyun.

videos.title: Episode 38
videos.overview: As Feng Lanxi arrives to Feng Xiyun’s rescue, he makes a discovery about Yu Wuyuan. A ceasefire allows for a happy union a year later.

videos.title: Episode 39
videos.overview: Huang Chao and Feng Lanxi have their long-awaited rematch on the battlefield. Meanwhile, Yu Wuyuan’s master plan finally falls into place.

videos.title: Episode 40
videos.overview: Reeling from shock, Feng Xiyun goes all out to exact revenge... with dire consequences. Feng Lanxi, Feng Xiyun and Huang Chao face Yu Wuyuan at last.
